d.ko: A string of mysterious wind chimes brought three lovely and uninvited kemonomimi girls to this small convenience store. At such a summer night full of surprises and excitement, what lies ahead on their road of adventure?
d.en: A string of mysterious wind chimes brought three lovely and uninvited kemonomimi girls to this small convenience store. At such a summer night full of surprises and excitement, what lies ahead on their road of adventure?
d.zh: 一串神秘的风铃，给一个小小的便利店带来了三位可爱的兽耳姑娘。在这个充满惊喜和忐忑的夏夜里，年轻的店长和他不请自来的三位新员工一起踏上了坎坷又欢乐的创业之路……
